name: Saffron the Tawny Cat
blurb: Saffron, a tawny-gold shorthair with a cream chin, deep gold eyes and a dark tip on her tail, sunbathes on the warm garden steps.

name: Sorrel the Sand-Gold Cat
blurb: Sorrel, a sleek sand-gold cat with a pale cream belly and dark-backed ears, pads quietly through the tall garden grass at dusk.

name: Marigold the Ruffled Cat
blurb: Marigold, a fluffy bronze-gold longhair with a thick ruff round her neck and faint bands on her tail, dozes in the flower bed.
